WITH
  sessions_a AS (
    SELECT
      uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) AS total
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_name = 'session_start'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND app_info_version = '${version_a}'
  ),
  sessions_b AS (
    SELECT
      uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) AS total
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_name = 'session_start'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND app_info_version = '${version_b}'
  ),
  events_a AS (
    SELECT
      event_name,
      count() AS cnt
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND app_info_version = '${version_a}'
    GROUP BY event_name
  ),
  events_b AS (
    SELECT
      event_name,
      count() AS cnt
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND app_info_version = '${version_b}'
    GROUP BY event_name
  )
SELECT
  coalesce(a.event_name, b.event_name) AS "Event",
  round(ifNull(a.cnt, 0) / sa.total, 4) AS "🅰️ ${version_a}",
  round(ifNull(b.cnt, 0) / sb.total, 4) AS "🅱️ ${version_b}",
  round(
    ifNull(b.cnt, 0) / sb.total
    - ifNull(a.cnt, 0) / sa.total,
    4
  ) AS "Delta"
FROM events_a AS a
FULL OUTER JOIN events_b AS b ON a.event_name = b.event_name
CROSS JOIN sessions_a AS sa
CROSS JOIN sessions_b AS sb
ORDER BY "Event"

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  daily_sessions AS (
    SELECT
      event_date,
      uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) AS total_sessions
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_name = 'session_start'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND app_info_version = '${version_a}'
    GROUP BY event_date
  ),
  daily_events AS (
    SELECT
      event_date,
      count() AS total_events
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_name = '${event_name}'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND app_info_version = '${version_a}'
    GROUP BY event_date
  )
SELECT
  daily_sessions.event_date AS TIME,
  round(
    ifNull(daily_events.total_events, 0) / daily_sessions.total_sessions,
    4
  ) AS "Events per Session"
FROM daily_sessions
LEFT JOIN daily_events
  ON daily_sessions.event_date = daily_events.event_date
ORDER BY TIME
